text: Compare what users send (api checkouts per second) with what inventory receives (make metrics). If inventory gets several times more requests than users make, who is sending the rest?
Read .state/config/history/CHANGELOG.md. Two changes went out the same day; the traffic spike only tipped the system over. Restoring capacity alone does not end a storm that the retries keep feeding.
A sane client: a few retries at most, exponential backoff with jitter, and a timeout above the service's real latency. Serving a static fallback hides the outage and is graded as a regression.
